From: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@helixtx.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@helixtx.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual success plan + evaluation runbook for Helix pilot

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Helix is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. We had a quick internal sync and want to get a MAP and an evaluation runbook in place so we can move to a 30-day pilot.

High-level asks from our side: 
- A one-page stakeholder heatmap so we can align exec/engineering/ops owners.
- A short evaluation runbook that lists acceptance criteria (latency targets, throughput profile, privacy checks).
- A proposed 30-day timeline with milestones and decision gates.

Could you share a template you typically use and a first-pass MAP we can co-edit? Also looping in Carlos (Head of Integrations) — he will own the engineering touchpoints.

Thanks,
Bethany
Bethany Cole
Business Development
Helix Therapeutics

Attachments: helix-arch-highlevel.pdf (attachment stub)

Hi Bethany — great to hear. I put together a short MAP template and a stakeholder heatmap to kick things off and added an initial runbook draft. Please find the links below; happy to co-edit in real time.

Quick summary of what I shared:
- Redwood MAP template (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c_helix_map_shared
- Stakeholder heatmap (spreadsheet): helix-stakeholder-heatmap.xlsx (attached)
- Pilot evaluation runbook (PDF export): pilot-eval-runbook.pdf (attached)
- 30-day timeline (Slides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/30day-timeline

Proposed next steps:
1) You and Carlos review the heatmap and drop in stakeholder names/levels by EOD Thursday.
2) Marissa and Dev will host a 45-min kickoff workshop next Monday to align success criteria and integration checkpoints.
3) We’ll circulate an updated MAP with milestone owners within 48 hours of the workshop.

Marissa — would you and Dev be willing to run the workshop? I think Jonas should be on the call for architecture questions; I’ve CC'd him on a follow-up calendar invite (below).

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: helix-stakeholder-heatmap.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot-eval-runbook.pdf (document)
